core_full_remote_readback.byte_origin: Fresh bare repository without alternates; remote tree then explicit remote blob fetch; every task blob fully cat-file read, no local publication-byte cache reused

final_binding.readback: Final binding will be checked in a second fresh bare remote store after ordinary push; actual immutable commit/tree and full-byte result delivered externally, without writing a self-referential successor receipt.

qualification: Readback checks byte identity and publication protection only; it is not main semantic reception, source-body approval, or behavior execution.
